notes: Too vague to use a fact (rule 12); doesn't restate the recommendation (rule 13).

responses.value: Close the 4 mall showrooms and push online rentals. Those 4 cause 80% of the losses, all in malls that lost their anchor stores, while the other 11 showrooms are profitable. Online rentals grew 30% last year to a quarter of revenue, so they can absorb the closed stores' customers. The main risk is the cost of closing early, about 6 months' rent each. The next step is to negotiate lease exits and move their stock online.
